(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Fast deterministic safety loop: evaluates hardware E-stops, passive freeze plug margin,   *)
(* containment boundary, critical redox boundary runaway, and vessel strain integrity.       *)

bHardwareTripCondition       := FALSE;
bThermalFreezeHazard         := FALSE;
bOverTemperatureHazard       := FALSE;
bOxidizingRunawayHazard      := FALSE;
bReducingPrecipitationHazard := FALSE;
bGasVoidReactivityHazard     := FALSE;
bVesselRuptureStrainHazard   := FALSE;
bContainmentBreachHazard     := FALSE;
bCorrosionRateExceededHazard := FALSE;

(* SIL-3 Dual-channel Active-low Emergency Stop Relay Monitoring *)
IF (NOT bEmergencyStop_CH1) OR (NOT bEmergencyStop_CH2) THEN
    bHardwareTripCondition := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardwired E-Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

(* Plant Protection System (PPS) Master Scram Permissive *)
IF NOT bReactorScramPermissive THEN
    bHardwareTripCondition := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Reactor PPS Core Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Passive Molten Salt Freeze Plug Safety Thermal Margin *)
IF NOT bSafetyFreezePlugHealthy THEN
    bHardwareTripCondition := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Passive Freeze Plug Depleted *)
END_IF;

(* Containment Boundary Isolation Breach Interlock *)
IF NOT bContainmentIsolationClosed THEN
    bContainmentBreachHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Containment Barrier Open *)
END_IF;

(* Molten Salt Freeze Crystallization Prevention Interlock (< 565°C) *)
IF (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC < 565.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC < 565.0) THEN
    bThermalFreezeHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Fuel Salt Solidification Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Core Fuel Salt Overtemperature Thermal Stress Interlock (> 725°C) *)
IF (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC > 725.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC > 725.0) THEN
    bOverTemperatureHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Core Extreme Overtemperature *)
END_IF;

(* Catastrophic Fluorine Potential Runaway (U4+/U3+ Ratio > 220 mol/mol) *)
IF (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio > 220.0) THEN
    bOxidizingRunawayHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Severe Oxidizing Runaway *)
END_IF;

(* Severe Over-Reduction Actinide Precipitation Hazard (U4+/U3+ Ratio < 5.0 mol/mol) *)
IF (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio < 5.0) AND (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio > 0.01) THEN
    bReducingPrecipitationHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Severe Over-Reduction Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Core Reactivity Void Fraction Carryunder Interlock (> 0.25% void fraction) *)
IF (rSaltVoidFractionSensor_pct > 0.25) THEN
    bGasVoidReactivityHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Gas Void Reactivity Exceeded *)
END_IF;

(* Hastelloy-N Vessel Wall Mechanical Hoop Microstrain Failure (> 1850 microstrain) *)
IF (rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH1 > 1850.0) OR (rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH2 > 1850.0) THEN
    bVesselRuptureStrainHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Vessel Wall Hoop Overstrain *)
END_IF;

(* Catastrophic Corrosion Rate Boundary (> 60.0 um/year) *)
IF (rCorrosionRate_um_yr > 60.0) THEN
    bCorrosionRateExceededHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: Extreme Structural Corrosion *)
END_IF;

(* Overall SIL-3 Master Safety Trip Asserted *)
bEmergencyTripActive := bHardwareTripCondition OR
                        bThermalFreezeHazard OR
                        bOverTemperatureHazard OR
                        bOxidizingRunawayHazard OR
                        bReducingPrecipitationHazard OR
                        bGasVoidReactivityHazard OR
                        bVesselRuptureStrainHazard OR
                        bContainmentBreachHazard OR
                        bCorrosionRateExceededHazard;

(* Safety Actuator Clamp on Emergency Trip *)
IF bEmergencyTripActive THEN
    bBeRodFastEjectionActive := TRUE;
    rBeRodPositionCmd_mm     := 0.0;    (* Retract Beryllium rod instantly from molten salt *)
    bH2SupplyIsolated        := TRUE;
    rH2MassFlowCmd_sccm      := 0.0;    (* Slam shut dual-redundant hydrogen isolation valves *)
    rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct  := 100.0;  (* Dump centrifugal separator to maximize gas release *)
    rHeStrippingFlowCmd_sccm := 100.0;  (* Maintain bare minimum blanket purge, stop bubble stripping *)
    bSystemReady             := FALSE;
    iState                   := 100;    (* Force FSM to State 100: EMERGENCY_SCRAM_DRAIN *)
END_IF;

(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & SENSOR HEALTH DIAGNOSTICS             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-reliability median selection and deviation monitoring for SIL-3 instrumentation:     *)
(* - Electrochemical Potentiometry (rRedoxPotential_A, B, C)                                 *)
(* - Fuel Salt Bulk Temperature (rSaltCoreTemp_A, B, C)                                      *)
(* - Reduction Sparger Manifold Pressure (rSpargerInletPress_A, B)                           *)
(* - Off-Gas Fission Xe-135 Activity (rOffGasXe135Activity_A, B, C)                         *)

(* --- 2.1 Online Potentiometric Sensor 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rPot_Diff_AB := ABS(rRedoxPotential_A_mV - rRedoxPotential_B_mV);
rPot_Diff_BC := ABS(rRedoxPotential_B_mV - rRedoxPotential_C_mV);
rPot_Diff_CA := ABS(rRedoxPotential_C_mV - rRedoxPotential_A_mV);

(* Sensor plausibility bounds: -650 mV to -150 mV vs Ni/NiF2 reference *)
bPot_Healthy_A := (rRedoxPotential_A_mV >= -650.0) AND (rRedoxPotential_A_mV <= -150.0);
bPot_Healthy_B := (rRedoxPotential_B_mV >= -650.0) AND (rRedoxPotential_B_mV <= -150.0);
bPot_Healthy_C := (rRedoxPotential_C_mV >= -650.0) AND (rRedoxPotential_C_mV <= -150.0);

(* Deviation tolerance: 25.0 mV allowable spread between channels *)
IF rPot_Diff_AB > 25.0 THEN
    IF rPot_Diff_BC <= 25.0 THEN
        bPot_Healthy_A := FALSE; (* Channel A drifting *)
    ELSIF rPot_Diff_CA <= 25.0 THEN
        bPot_Healthy_B := FALSE; (* Channel B drifting *)
    ELSE
        bPot_Healthy_C := FALSE; (* Ambiguous multiple drift *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rPot_Diff_BC > 25.0 THEN
    IF (rPot_Diff_AB <= 25.0) AND bPot_Healthy_A THEN
        bPot_Healthy_C := FALSE; (* Channel C drifting *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Calculate healthy channel count *)
iPot_Healthy_Count := 0;
IF bPot_Healthy_A THEN iPot_Healthy_Count := iPot_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bPot_Healthy_B THEN iPot_Healthy_Count := iPot_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bPot_Healthy_C THEN iPot_Healthy_Count := iPot_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;

(* Median Selection Logic *)
IF iPot_Healthy_Count = 3 THEN
    (* Perfect 2oo3 Median voting among 3 channels *)
    IF (rRedoxPotential_A_mV >= rRedoxPotential_B_mV AND rRedoxPotential_A_mV <= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) OR
       (rRedoxPotential_A_mV <= rRedoxPotential_B_mV AND rRedoxPotential_A_mV >= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_A_mV;
    ELSIF (rRedoxPotential_B_mV >= rRedoxPotential_A_mV AND rRedoxPotential_B_mV <= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) OR
          (rRedoxPotential_B_mV <= rRedoxPotential_A_mV AND rRedoxPotential_B_mV >= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_B_mV;
    ELSE
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_C_mV;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPot_Healthy_Count = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 average voting *)
    IF bPot_Healthy_A AND bPot_Healthy_B THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := (rRedoxPotential_A_mV + rRedoxPotential_B_mV) * 0.50;
    ELSIF bPot_Healthy_B AND bPot_Healthy_C THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := (rRedoxPotential_B_mV + rRedoxPotential_C_mV) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := (rRedoxPotential_A_mV + rRedoxPotential_C_mV) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Warning: Potentiometry 1oo2 degraded *)
ELSIF iPot_Healthy_Count = 1 THEN
    (* Severe degradation: single remaining channel *)
    IF bPot_Healthy_A THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_A_mV;
    ELSIF bPot_Healthy_B THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_B_mV;
    ELSE
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_C_mV;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Warning: Potentiometry 1oo1 critical degraded *)
ELSE
    (* Total sensor failure: Fallback to last filtered value *)
    rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rFiltRedoxPotential_mV;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_2000; (* Alarm: Loss of all potentiometry *)
END_IF;

(* Exponential Smoothing Noise Rejection Filter on Redox Potential *)
rFiltRedoxPotential_mV := (alpha_RedoxFilter * rVotedRedoxPotential_mV) +
                          ((1.0 - alpha_RedoxFilter) * rFiltRedoxPotential_mV);

(* Dynamic Derivative (Rate-of-Change) Evaluation [mV/s] *)
rRedoxRateOfChange_mV_s := (rFiltRedoxPotential_mV - rHistRedox_1) / tSampleTaskInterval_s;
rHistRedox_3 := rHistRedox_2;
rHistRedox_2 := rHistRedox_1;
rHistRedox_1 := rFiltRedoxPotential_mV;

(* --- 2.2 Fuel Salt Bulk Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rTemp_Diff_AB := ABS(rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC - rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC);
rTemp_Diff_BC := ABS(rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC - rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC);
rTemp_Diff_CA := ABS(rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC - rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC);

bTemp_Healthy_B := (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC >= 550.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC <= 750.0);
bTemp_Healthy_C := (rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC >= 550.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC <= 750.0);

    IF rTemp_Diff_BC <= 20.0 THEN bTemp_Healthy_A := FALSE;

IF bTemp_Healthy_A THEN iTemp_Healthy_Count := iTemp_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bTemp_Healthy_B THEN iTemp_Healthy_Count := iTemp_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bTemp_Healthy_C THEN iTemp_Healthy_Count := iTemp_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;

IF iTemp_Healthy_Count = 3 THEN
    IF (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) OR
       (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC;
    ELSIF (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) OR
          (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC;
    ELSE
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTemp_Healthy_Count = 2 THEN
    IF bTemp_Healthy_A AND bTemp_Healthy_B THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC + rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC) * 0.50;
    ELSIF bTemp_Healthy_B AND bTemp_Healthy_C THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC + rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC + rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Warning: Temp 1oo2 degraded *)
ELSE
    rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC;
END_IF;

rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC := (alpha_TempFilter * rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC) +
                          ((1.0 - alpha_TempFilter) * rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC);

(* --- 2.3 Off-Gas Fission Gas Xe-135 Activity 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rXe_Diff_AB := ABS(rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 - rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3);
rXe_Diff_BC := ABS(rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 - rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3);
rXe_Diff_CA := ABS(rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3 - rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3);

bXe_Healthy_A := (rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 >= 0.0);
bXe_Healthy_B := (rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 >= 0.0);
bXe_Healthy_C := (rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3 >= 0.0);

iXe_Healthy_Count := 0;
IF bXe_Healthy_A THEN iXe_Healthy_Count := iXe_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bXe_Healthy_B THEN iXe_Healthy_Count := iXe_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bXe_Healthy_C THEN iXe_Healthy_Count := iXe_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;

IF iXe_Healthy_Count = 3 THEN
    IF (rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) OR
       (rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) THEN
        rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3;
    ELSIF (rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) OR
          (rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) THEN
        rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3;
    ELSE
        rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iXe_Healthy_Count >= 1 THEN
    IF bXe_Healthy_A THEN rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3;
    ELSIF bXe_Healthy_B THEN rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3;
    ELSE rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFiltOffGasXe_Bq_m3 := (alpha_XeFilter * rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3) +
                       ((1.0 - alpha_XeFilter) * rFiltOffGasXe_Bq_m3);


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 THERMODYNAMIC EQUILIBRIUM & NERNSTIAN ELECTROCHEMICAL REDOX REGULATION                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Inverts the voted electrochemical cell potential [mV] using temperature-corrected         *)
(* Nernst-Einstein thermodynamics to obtain the online molar ratio [U4+]/[U3+]:              *)
(*   E_cell(T) = E0(T) + (R * T / (n * F)) * ln( (gamma_UF4 / gamma_UF3) * ([U4+]/[U3+]) )   *)

(* Convert voted temperature to thermodynamic Kelvin *)
rT_Kelvin := rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC + STANDARD_TEMP_K;
IF rT_Kelvin < 800.0 THEN rT_Kelvin := 800.0; END_IF; (* Safeguard against zero division *)

(* Temperature-dependent standard reduction potential E0(T) [V] *)
rE0_T_Volt := E0_REF_POTENTIAL_V + (D_E0_DT_COEFF * (rT_Kelvin - NOMINAL_CORE_TEMP_K));

(* Thermodynamic Nernstian Slope factor: (R_u * T) / (n * F) with n = 1 *)
rNernstSlope_V := (R_GAS_CONST * rT_Kelvin) / FARADAY_CONST;

(* Potential offset in Volts: Convert filtered mV to Volts *)
rDelta_E_Volt := (rFiltRedoxPotential_mV * 0.0010) - rE0_T_Volt;

(* Natural logarithm of molar concentration ratio *)
rLnRatio := (rDelta_E_Volt / rNernstSlope_V) - LN(ACTIVITY_COEFF_RATIO);

(* Anti-saturation bounds on exponent: prevent floating point overflow *)
IF rLnRatio > 7.50 THEN rLnRatio := 7.50; END_IF;       (* Equivalent to ratio approx 1800 *)
IF rLnRatio < 0.50 THEN rLnRatio := 0.50; END_IF;       (* Equivalent to ratio approx 1.65 *)

(* Online calculated U4+/U3+ molar ratio *)
rCalculatedU4U3Ratio := EXP(rLnRatio);

(* Control deviation from setpoint in logarithmic space *)
IF rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol < 10.0 THEN rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol := 10.0; END_IF;
IF rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol > 180.0 THEN rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol := 180.0; END_IF;

rRedoxError := LN(rCalculatedU4U3Ratio) - LN(rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol);

(* Setpoint Window Diagnostic Supervision *)
IF rCalculatedU4U3Ratio > 140.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Warning: Fuel salt oxidizing high *)
ELSIF rCalculatedU4U3Ratio < 35.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Warning: Fuel salt reducing low *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 PYROCHEMICAL MASS TRANSFER & MULTI-PHASE SPARGER HYDRODYNAMICS                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Co-regulates coarse reduction via submerged metallic Beryllium (Be) rod convective flux   *)
(* and fine trimming via porous Hydrogen (H2) sparging into the bypass molten salt stream.   *)

(* --- 4.1 Beryllium Rod Dissolution Convective Mass Transfer --- *)
(* Calculate hydrodynamic Reynolds and Schmidt numbers for submerged cylinder cross-flow:   *)
(* Re_rod = (rho_salt * v_bypass * d_rod) / mu_salt                                          *)
(* Salt velocity in bypass duct: v_bypass = rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h / (3600.0 * Area_duct)   *)
(* With bypass duct area approx 0.015 m2 (0.138 m inner diameter)                            *)
IF rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h > 0.10 THEN
    rWorkVal1 := rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h / (3600.0 * 0.0150); (* v_bypass [m/s] *)
ELSE
    rWorkVal1 := 0.050; (* Minimum convective natural circulation [m/s] *)
END_IF;

(* Reynolds number of beryllium cylinder *)
rRe_rod := (4125.0 * rWorkVal1 * BE_ROD_DIAMETER_M) / 0.0062;
IF rRe_rod < 10.0 THEN rRe_rod := 10.0; END_IF;

(* Schmidt number for dissolved Be in fluoride eutectic: Sc = mu / (rho * D_Be) *)
rSc_Be := 0.0062 / (4125.0 * DIFFUSIVITY_BE_SALT_M2_S); (* Sc approx 289.0 *)

(* Sherwood number correlation (Churchill-Bernstein / Whitaker): *)
(* Sh_rod = 0.30 + [ 0.62 * Re^0.5 * Sc^(1/3) ] / [ 1.0 + (0.4 / Sc)^(2/3) ]^0.25 *)
rWorkVal2 := (0.62 * SQRT(rRe_rod) * 6.6115) / 1.0022; (* Sc^(1/3) approx 6.6115 *)
rSh_rod := 0.30 + rWorkVal2;

(* Convective liquid-phase mass transfer coefficient k_L_Be [m/s] *)
rk_L_Be := (rSh_rod * DIFFUSIVITY_BE_SALT_M2_S) / BE_ROD_DIAMETER_M;

(* Beryllium surface dissolution flux [mol/(m2*s)] *)
(* Dependent on fluorine oxidation potential driving force (proportional to redox error) *)
IF rRedoxError > 0.0 THEN
    rMassFlux_Be := rk_L_Be * (rRedoxError * 85.0); (* Scaling flux based on U4+ driving force *)
ELSE
    rMassFlux_Be := 0.0; (* In setpoint equilibrium or slightly reducing *)
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Beryllium mass consumption tracking [grams] *)
(* dM/dt = J_Be * Area_exposed * MW_Be (MW_Be = 9.01218 g/mol) *)
IF rBeRodPositionFeedback_mm > 1.0 THEN
    rWorkVal3 := PI_CONST * BE_ROD_DIAMETER_M * (rBeRodPositionFeedback_mm * 0.0010); (* Area [m2] *)
    rCumulativeBerylliumBurn_grams := rCumulativeBerylliumBurn_grams +
        (rMassFlux_Be * rWorkVal3 * 9.01218 * tSampleTaskInterval_s);
END_IF;

(* --- 4.2 Hydrogen Gas Sparger Two-Film Interfacial Mass Transfer --- *)
(* Gas sparging delivery: 3% H2 in He carrier gas.                                          *)
(* Reaction: 1/2 H2(g) + UF4(salt) <===> UF3(salt) + HF(g)                                  *)
(* Interfacial specific area: a = 6.0 * alpha_sparge / d32                                   *)
IF rH2SpargerFlowFeedback_sccm > 5.0 THEN
    (* Gas volume fraction in sparger mixing zone *)
    rWorkVal4 := (rH2SpargerFlowFeedback_sccm * 1.6667e-8) / (rWorkVal1 * 0.0150);
    IF rWorkVal4 > 0.15 THEN rWorkVal4 := 0.15; END_IF;
    ra_sparge := (6.0 * rWorkVal4) / SAUTER_BUBBLE_DIAM_M;
ELSE
    ra_sparge := 10.0; (* Minimum residual interfacial area *)
END_IF;

(* Mass transfer coefficient for dissolved hydrogen *)
rk_L_H2 := 1.450e-4; (* Characteristic k_L for H2 in molten fluorides at 650°C [m/s] *)
rFlux_H2 := rk_L_H2 * ra_sparge * (rH2SpargerFlowFeedback_sccm / 1200.0);


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 FISSION GAS (Xe/Kr) BUBBLE NUCLEATION, STRIPPING & CYCLONIC EXTRACTION               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Models helium microbubble injection into the fuel salt slipstream, mass transfer of       *)
(* insoluble volatile fission products (Xe-135, Kr-88) into the bubbles, and subsequent      *)
(* centrifugal separation in an axial cyclone with strict gas void carryunder limits.        *)

(* Mass transfer coefficient for Xenon stripping: Higbie penetration model *)
(* k_L_Xe = 2.0 * SQRT( (D_Xe * v_bubble_slip) / (pi * d32) )                              *)
(* Characteristic slip velocity of 0.85 mm helium bubble in molten salt: v_slip approx 0.18 m/s *)
rk_L_Xe := 2.0 * SQRT( (DIFFUSIVITY_XE_SALT_M2_S * 0.180) / (PI_CONST * SAUTER_BUBBLE_DIAM_M) );

(* Specific bubble interfacial area for Helium stripping injection *)
IF rHeStrippingFlowFeedback_sccm > 50.0 THEN
    rWorkVal1 := (rHeStrippingFlowFeedback_sccm * 1.6667e-8) / (rWorkVal1 * 0.0150);
    IF rWorkVal1 > 0.12 THEN rWorkVal1 := 0.12; END_IF;
    ra_bubble := (6.0 * rWorkVal1) / SAUTER_BUBBLE_DIAM_M;
ELSE
    ra_bubble := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Volumetric removal rate of Xenon: dC_Xe/dt = - k_L_Xe * a_bubble * (C_Xe - C_sat) *)
rXeRemovalRate := rk_L_Xe * ra_bubble;

(* Centrifugal Separator G-force and Separation Efficiency *)
(* Tangential velocity inside axial cyclone barrel: v_tangential = (Q_bypass / A_inlet)     *)
(* G = v_tangential^2 / (R_cyclone * 9.81)                                                  *)
IF rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h > 0.50 THEN
    rWorkVal2 := (rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h / 3600.0) / 0.0028; (* v_tangential [m/s] *)
    rCentrifugalG := (rWorkVal2 * rWorkVal2) / (CYCLONE_RADIUS_M * 9.80665);
    IF rCentrifugalG < 15.0 THEN rCentrifugalG := 15.0; END_IF;
    IF rCentrifugalG > 180.0 THEN rCentrifugalG := 180.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCentrifugalG := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Cyclone bubble separation efficiency modeling *)
rSepEfficiency := 1.0 - EXP( - (rCentrifugalG * 0.0450) );
IF rSepEfficiency > 0.998 THEN rSepEfficiency := 0.998; END_IF;
IF rSepEfficiency < 0.750 THEN rSepEfficiency := 0.750; END_IF;

rXeExtractionEfficiency_pct := rSepEfficiency * 100.0;

(* Carryunder Gas Void Fraction returning to core loop *)
(* Void carryunder = injected gas void * (1.0 - rSepEfficiency) * throttle_factor *)
rWorkVal3 := (1.0 - rSepEfficiency) * (rHeStrippingFlowFeedback_sccm / 5000.0) * 0.85;
IF rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct > 10.0 THEN
    rGasVoidCalculated := rWorkVal3 * (100.0 / rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct);
ELSE
    rGasVoidCalculated := rWorkVal3 * 10.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp and smooth void fraction *)
IF rGasVoidCalculated < 0.001 THEN rGasVoidCalculated := 0.001; END_IF;
IF rGasVoidCalculated > 0.500 THEN rGasVoidCalculated := 0.500; END_IF;

rFiltVoidFraction_pct := (alpha_VoidFilter * rGasVoidCalculated) +
                         ((1.0 - alpha_VoidFilter) * rFiltVoidFraction_pct);
rCalculatedVoidFraction_pct := rFiltVoidFraction_pct;

(* Void Fraction Alarm Boundaries *)
IF rCalculatedVoidFraction_pct > 0.120 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Warning: High gas void fraction *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 STRUCTURAL NICKEL ALLOY (HASTELLOY-N) CORROSION IMPEDANCE & MICROSTRAIN KINETICS     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-temperature in-situ Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) evaluation:         *)
(* Extracts polarization resistance Rp, applies Stern-Geary to obtain corrosion current     *)
(* density i_corr, and computes Faradaic wall thinning rate CR [um/year].                    *)

(* Protect against zero/invalid polarization resistance *)
IF rEIS_PolarizationResist_Ohm > 100.0 THEN
    (* Polarization resistance corrected for solution resistance: Rp_corr = Rp - Rs *)
    rWorkVal1 := rEIS_PolarizationResist_Ohm - rEIS_SolutionResistance_Ohm;
    IF rWorkVal1 < 50.0 THEN rWorkVal1 := 50.0; END_IF;
    
    (* Stern-Geary equation for corrosion current density: i_corr = B / Rp [A/cm2] *)
    rI_corr_A_cm2 := STERN_GEARY_B_VOLT / rWorkVal1;
    rI_corr_uA_cm2 := rI_corr_A_cm2 * 1.0e6; (* Convert to uA/cm2 *)
    
    (* Faradaic corrosion rate: CR [um/year] = (i_corr * EW * 3.1536e7) / (rho * F) * 1.0e4 *)
    (* (EW * 3.1536e7 * 1.0e4) / (rho * F) for Hastelloy-N = (28.52 * 3.1536e11) / (8.86 * 96485.33) = 10515.6 *)
    rCorrosionRate_calc := rI_corr_A_cm2 * 10515.6 * 1.0e4;
ELSE
    (* Fallback estimation based on U4+/U3+ redox ratio and dissolved Cr *)
    rCorrosionRate_calc := 2.50 + (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio * 0.0850) + (rDissolvedChromium_ppm * 0.0350);
END_IF;

(* Bound and filter corrosion rate *)
IF rCorrosionRate_calc < 0.10 THEN rCorrosionRate_calc := 0.10; END_IF;
IF rCorrosionRate_calc > 120.0 THEN rCorrosionRate_calc := 120.0; END_IF;

rFiltCorrosionRate_um_yr := (alpha_CorrosionFilter * rCorrosionRate_calc) +
                            ((1.0 - alpha_CorrosionFilter) * rFiltCorrosionRate_um_yr);
rCorrosionRate_um_yr := rFiltCorrosionRate_um_yr;

(* High Corrosion Rate Warning *)
IF rCorrosionRate_um_yr > 15.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Warning: Hastelloy corrosion rate high *)
END_IF;

(* Filter and monitor reactor vessel wall hoop microstrain *)
rWorkVal2 := (rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH1 + rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH2) * 0.50;
rFiltVesselMicrostrain := (alpha_StrainFilter * rWorkVal2) +
                          ((1.0 - alpha_StrainFilter) * rFiltVesselMicrostrain);

IF rFiltVesselMicrostrain > 1200.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Warning: Vessel hoop microstrain elevated *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Multivariable cyber-physical governor:                                                    *)
(*   x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k]                                                           *)
(*   y[k]   = C * x[k] + D * u[k]                                                           *)
(* Solves an embedded quadratic cost function via projected gradient descent with Hessian    *)
(* preconditioning and actuator saturation constraints:                                      *)
(*   min J = (x_pred - x_ref)^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref)                                       *)
(*         + (u - u_ref)^T * R * (u - u_ref) + delta_u^T * S * delta_u                       *)

(* First-Scan State-Space Model Matrix Population (T_s = 0.200 s) *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Discrete Transition Matrix A (6x6) *)
    A_mat[1,1] := 0.9820; A_mat[1,2] := 0.0005; A_mat[1,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[1,4] := 0.0012; A_mat[1,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[1,6] := 0.0045;
    A_mat[2,1] := 0.0125; A_mat[2,2] := 0.9950; A_mat[2,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[2,6] := 0.0250;
    A_mat[3,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,3] := 0.9200; A_mat[3,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,5] := 0.0150;  A_mat[3,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[4,1] := 0.0020; A_mat[4,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,4] := 0.9980; A_mat[4,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[4,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[5,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,5] := 0.8500;  A_mat[5,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[6,1] := 0.0850; A_mat[6,2] := 0.0150; A_mat[6,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[6,6] := 0.9650;

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B (6x4) *)
    (* Inputs: u1=Be rod [mm], u2=H2 flow [sccm], u3=He stripping [sccm], u4=Cyclone throttle [%] *)
    B_mat[1,1] := -0.00420; B_mat[1,2] := -0.00085; B_mat[1,3] := 0.00005;  B_mat[1,4] := 0.00000;
    B_mat[2,1] := -0.00150; B_mat[2,2] := -0.00030; B_mat[2,3] := 0.00000;  B_mat[2,4] := 0.00000;
    B_mat[3,1] := 0.00000;  B_mat[3,2] := 0.00000;  B_mat[3,3] := -0.00065; B_mat[3,4] := -0.00015;
    B_mat[4,1] := 0.00080;  B_mat[4,2] := 0.00000;  B_mat[4,3] := 0.00000;  B_mat[4,4] := 0.00000;
    B_mat[5,1] := 0.00000;  B_mat[5,2] := 0.00002;  B_mat[5,3] := 0.00008;  B_mat[5,4] := -0.00250;
    B_mat[6,1] := -0.00350; B_mat[6,2] := -0.00075; B_mat[6,3] := 0.00000;  B_mat[6,4] := 0.00000;

    (* Output Observation Matrix C (4x6 Identity Selection) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 1.0;
            ELSE
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Direct Feedthrough Matrix D (4x4 Zero) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            D_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Diagonal State Penalty Weights Q (6 states) *)
    Q_diag[1] := 120.0;     (* Heavy penalty on Redox Ratio tracking error *)
    Q_diag[2] := 5.0;       (* Penalty on leached chromium accumulation *)
    Q_diag[3] := 45.0;      (* Strong penalty on residual Xe-135 noble gas inventory *)
    Q_diag[4] := 1.5;       (* Minor penalty on Beryllium rod consumption *)
    Q_diag[5] := 250.0;     (* Extreme penalty on core gas void fraction *)
    Q_diag[6] := 80.0;      (* High penalty on structural alloy corrosion current *)

    (* Diagonal Control Action Weights R (4 actuators) *)
    R_diag[1] := 0.025;     (* Beryllium rod movement cost *)
    R_diag[2] := 0.050;     (* Hydrogen sparger gas consumption cost *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.010;     (* Helium stripping flow cost *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.080;     (* Cyclone throttle movement cost *)

    (* Diagonal Slew Rate (Delta-U) Suppression Weights S (4 actuators) *)
    S_diag[1] := 0.850;     (* Suppress aggressive Be rod mechanical oscillations *)
    S_diag[2] := 0.450;     (* Smooth hydrogen flow controller transients *)
    S_diag[3] := 0.150;     (* Smooth helium bubble injection transitions *)
    S_diag[4] := 0.650;     (* Prevent violent cyclone throttle hunting *)

    (* Actuator Hard Saturation Limits *)
    u_min[1] := 0.0;    u_max[1] := BE_ROD_MAX_STROKE_MM;   (* Be rod: 0 to 250 mm *)
    u_min[2] := 0.0;    u_max[2] := 1200.0;                 (* H2 flow: 0 to 1200 sccm *)
    u_min[3] := 200.0;  u_max[3] := 5000.0;                 (* He stripping: 200 to 5000 sccm *)
    u_min[4] := 15.0;   u_max[4] := 95.0;                   (* Cyclone throttle: 15 to 95 % *)

    (* Maximum Permissible Slew Rate per Execution Scan (0.2 s) *)
    delta_u_max[1] := 2.50;     (* Max 12.5 mm/s Be rod drive speed *)
    delta_u_max[2] := 25.0;     (* Max 125 sccm/s H2 MFC ramping *)
    delta_u_max[3] := 100.0;    (* Max 500 sccm/s He MFC ramping *)
    delta_u_max[4] := 5.0;      (* Max 25 %/s cyclone valve stroking *)

    (* Diagonal Hessian Approximations: H_m approx 2 * (sum_n B[n,m]^2 * Q[n] + R[m] + S[m]) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        rWorkVal1 := 2.0 * (rTempSum + R_diag[iCol] + S_diag[iCol]);
        IF rWorkVal1 > 0.001 THEN
            inv_Hessian_diag[iCol] := 1.0 / rWorkVal1;
        ELSE
            inv_Hessian_diag[iCol] := 1.0;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Assemble Real-Time Current State Vector x_state *)
x_state[1] := rRedoxError;
x_state[2] := rDissolvedChromium_ppm;
x_state[3] := rFiltOffGasXe_Bq_m3 * 1.0e-10; (* Scaled dimensionless activity *)
x_state[4] := rCumulativeBerylliumBurn_grams * 0.010;
x_state[5] := rCalculatedVoidFraction_pct;
x_state[6] := rI_corr_uA_cm2;

(* Assemble State Setpoint Reference Vector x_ref *)
x_ref[1] := 0.0;        (* Target redox ratio error is zero (ln(ratio) = ln(target)) *)
x_ref[2] := 10.0;       (* Baseline background chromium limit [ppm] *)
x_ref[3] := 0.0;        (* Target residual Xenon activity in salt is zero *)
x_ref[4] := 0.0;        (* Minimize cumulative beryllium consumption *)
x_ref[5] := 0.025;      (* Target optimal bubbly flow void fraction: 0.025% *)
x_ref[6] := 0.250;      (* Target ultra-low corrosion current: 0.25 uA/cm2 *)

(* Actuator Baseline Reference Vector u_ref *)
u_ref[1] := 15.0;       (* Baseline shallow Be rod immersion [mm] *)
u_ref[2] := 150.0;      (* Baseline H2 trimming flow [sccm] *)
u_ref[3] := 1500.0;     (* Nominal He bubble stripping flow [sccm] *)
u_ref[4] := 65.0;       (* Nominal cyclone throttle position [%] *)

(* Forward One-Step State Prediction: x_pred = A * x_state + B * u_ctrl *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_ctrl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    x_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
    x_error[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Optimization: 3 Unrolled Iterations per Scan *)
FOR iGradIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Compute Analytical Gradient: grad_J[m] = dJ/du[m] *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (2.0 * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * x_error[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (2.0 * R_diag[iCol] * (u_ctrl[iCol] - u_ref[iCol]));
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (2.0 * S_diag[iCol] * (u_ctrl[iCol] - u_prev[iCol]));
        grad_J[iCol] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;

    (* Update Control Actions: du = - alpha * inv_H * grad_J *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        delta_u[iCol] := - rStepSize * inv_Hessian_diag[iCol] * grad_J[iCol];
        
        (* Apply Slew Rate Bounds *)
        IF delta_u[iCol] > delta_u_max[iCol] THEN
            delta_u[iCol] := delta_u_max[iCol];
        ELSIF delta_u[iCol] < -delta_u_max[iCol] THEN
            delta_u[iCol] := -delta_u_max[iCol];
        END_IF;
        
        (* Integrate Control Action *)
        u_ctrl[iCol] := u_ctrl[iCol] + delta_u[iCol];
